Generate Philippine mobile numbers

Source: R/contact.R
fkr_mobile_number.Rd

Draws mobile numbers using real network prefixes (Smart/TNT, Globe/TM, or DITO).

Usage

fkr_mobile_number(
  n,
  network = c("any", "smart", "globe", "dito"),
  format = c("local", "international")
)

Arguments

n

Number of mobile numbers to generate. A single non-negative whole number.

network

Restrict the draw to "smart", "globe", or "dito" prefixes, or "any" (default) to mix all networks.

format

"local" (default) returns "09XXXXXXXXX"; "international" returns "+639XXXXXXXXX".

Value

A character vector of length n.

Examples

fkr_mobile_number(5)
#> [1] "09293465232" "09993921523" "09493944694" "09367429636" "09190527339"
fkr_mobile_number(5, network = "globe", format = "international")
#> [1] "+639765489353" "+639178537507" "+639055440851" "+639562765829"
#> [5] "+639174816997"
